report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy: error_rate 0.0014, p95 70ms, one OK checkout span, INFO 200 logs, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters. This contradicts the alert and does not establish any bounded root cause. Downstream services in the topology were not observed, so the fault cannot be localized. Handing off for downstream and alert-window evidence.
